name: 11217 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11217 (Brooklyn) has 293 nonprofit organizations. 129 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 108 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11217 (Brooklyn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
